name: The Rookie
tagline: An empty cup holds the most
wisdomRoot: Shoshin — Zen beginner's mind (Shunryu Suzuki): in the beginner's mind there are many possibilities; in the expert's, few.
bio: The wide-eyed first-timer. Says yes first, and asks what everyone else was too proud to.
sceneStory: At the crumbling edge of a floating clifftop, a figure steps out into open air with both arms flung wide and their head tipped back. From a rip in the sky above, a waterfall of stars pours straight down over them, catching them mid-stride.
assignments: Act a fool so others can follow
